text_blocks.snippet: In 2021, the annual average inflation rate, as measured by the Consumer Price Index (CPI), was 4.7%. The monthly inflation rates varied throughout the year, with figures ranging from 0.3% in January to 0.8% in April. By the end of the year, the December-to-December increase was 7.0%, the largest increase since 1981.
